headline: Ether Long-To-Short Ratio Falls 0.34 To 1.90
narrative: Ether's long-to-short account ratio on OKX fell to 1.90, down 0.34 over 24 hours, while the seven-day change is still up 0.20. The reading is the 71.8th percentile of the last 30 days, in a span that runs from 1.0 to 2.73. The ratio counts long accounts against short accounts at that venue, not dollars, so 1.90 means long accounts outweigh short accounts by 1.90 to 1, and the drop means long accounts lost ground to short accounts.
author: jordan
